info.name: ALTR Datastore Information Service Data Discovery API

params.name: databaseId
params.description: The ALTR Database ID to run a classification/tagging job on. Can be found via the listDBs endpoint.

params.name: classificationType
params.description:
The secondary service used for classification/tagging jobs. Defaults to Google DLP if not included.

{
1, // Google DLP
2, // Snowflake Native (Deprecated)
3, // Snowflake Object Tag Import
4, // Snowflake Classification and Tag Import
}

params.name: emailOnCompletion
params.description:
Defaults to sending an email, this header allows you to opt in or out of the job completion email.

{
0, // False
1 // True
}

items.docs: Starts a classification job for the request client database.

info.name: Retrieve list of connected client databases.

params.name: offset
params.description: List return offset. Minimum 0.

params.name: limit
params.description: List return limit. Minimum 1, Maximum 100.

params.name: jobStarted
params.description: jobStarted, if not specified, will not be considered when returning data. If false, we will only return databases that have never had a data discovery job run. If true, the returned set will include databases that have had data discovery jobs started - even if they haven't completed.

params.name: jobCompleted
params.description: jobCompleted, if not specified, will not be considered when returning data. If false, we will only return databases that have never had a data discovery job complete. If true, we will only return databases that have had a data discovery job successfully complete.

items.docs: Gets a list of databases for consumption, includes if a classification has ever been run before.

params.name: dataDiscoveryJobType
params.description:
Filter by the secondary service used for classification/tagging jobs.

1, // Google DLP
2, // Snowflake Native (Deprecated)
3, // Snowflake Tag Import
4, // Snowflake Classify and Tag Import
}

params.description: List return offset. Minimum 0.
